# U150: Stopped goals listed: as Rhea, a goal stopped with a reason is gone from Goals and listed with the State filter on Stopped (“1 stopped goal, most recently stopped first.”), with the Stopped mark, who stopped it and when, and the reason; the Filters sheet’s State offers Active, Proposed and Stopped; Remove goes back to the active goals

- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `GOAL-STOP`, `GOAL-PROPOSED`
- **Budget:** at most 15 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** all ten points ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Rhea, at `/goals/ci-docker` in the demo on Wednesday 11 November 2026.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U150

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Rhea (`rhea`).
- Go to `/goals/ci-docker` in the demo on Wednesday 11 November 2026.
- **Check:** The goal’s summary bar shows.
- **Step.** From the goal’s “…” menu (More about this goal), choose “Stop this goal”.
- **Check:** (`entry`) the “Stop this goal” dialog is visible (else: Stop this goal, in the goal’s menu, opens no dialog).
- _Note:_ Without a reason it doesn't stop: it says why it needs one, and the goal is as it was.
- **Step.** Press the “Stop the goal” button in the “Stop this goal” dialog.
- **Check:** (`errors`) it fails if stopping without a reason isn’t refused in words, or stops the goal anyway.
- **Step.** Type “The platform team took base images over in October.” into the “Why is it stopping?” field in the “Stop this goal” dialog.
- **Step.** Press the “Stop the goal” button in the “Stop this goal” dialog.
- **Check:** “Stopped Base image build time” is shown (else: no message that it stopped).
- **Check:** (`progress`) scored as met here.
- **Check:** (`logged`) it fails if the stop wasn’t saved with who and why.
- Go to `/goals?scope=all&state=stopped` in the demo on Wednesday 11 November 2026.
- **Check:** “Filtered by: Stopped” is shown (else: the stopped list doesn’t say its filter).
- **Check:** “1 stopped goal, most recently stopped first.” is shown (else: the stopped list doesn’t count the stopped goal).
- **Check:** (`attention`) the li in the goals"] in the [data part="Stopped (`[data-part="Stopped goals"] li`) is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- **Check:** (`finish`) it fails if the stopped row reads “{says}”.
- **Check:** (`a11y`) there are 1 of the life mark (`.life-mark`) in the li in the goals"] in the [data part="Stopped (`[data-part="Stopped goals"] li`) and a status shape in the li in the goals"] in the [data part="Stopped (`[data-part="Stopped goals"] li`) is not there (else: a stopped row doesn’t draw the Stopped mark, or draws a status shape).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “stopped list”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Remove” button.
- **Check:** The address changes.
- **Check:** The Goals count line shows.
- _Note:_ The address changes before the list is drawn again, and the count line is on both, so wait for the stopped list to go; reading at once counted the old list's row (U150 at 9/10, 13 Nov).
- **Check:** The goals"] in the [data part="Stopped (`[data-part="Stopped goals"]`) goes away.
- _Note:_ The goal's rows, not the page's text: the toast that it stopped may still be showing.
- **Check:** (`finish`) the a in the main (`main a[href$="/goals/ci-docker"]`) is not there (else: the stopped goal is listed among the active goals).

How to read these lines: [the journeys](../../core/journeys.md#how-to-read-a-journeys-steps).
